answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh pearl. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the orchard of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. So a relic of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1ykkx.
